metrics.name: Console User Count
metrics.gotcha: Key is lowercase 'users' (not 'Users'). Each user entry has: id, role, email, roleId, status, lastname, firstname, timezone, twoFactorEnable (boolean).

metrics.name: Destination List Count
metrics.gotcha: destinationLists is an OBJECT {data: Array, meta: {total, page, limit}, status: {...}} — NOT a plain array. length(destinationLists) returns 3 (key count). Use destinationLists.meta.total for the entry count.

metrics.name: Encrypted Roaming Client Count
metrics.gotcha: roamingComputers[].status is a STRING. Confirmed values include 'Encrypted'. Use single-quoted string comparison.

metrics.name: Roaming Client Inventory
metrics.jmesPathQuery: roamingComputers[*].{name: name, os: osVersionName, version: version, status: status, lastSync: lastSync, daysSinceSync: daysSinceLastSync_r}
metrics.gotcha: status is a string (e.g. 'Encrypted'). daysSinceLastSync_r is Liongard-computed integer. osVersionName is a human-readable OS string.

metrics.name: Stale Roaming Client Count
metrics.gotcha: daysSinceLastSync_r is a Liongard-computed integer (days since last sync). Value 0 = synced today. Adjust threshold in recipe customize block.

metrics.name: Virtual Appliance Inventory
metrics.jmesPathQuery: virtualAppliances[*].{name: name, state: state, health: health, isUpgradable: isUpgradable, site: siteId}
